attempts.detail: The registered artifact failed to load because the bundled runner reported unknown model architecture mllama.
One real four-frame review remained incomplete beyond three minutes and was operator-interrupted; the model remains eligible only for a bounded disagreement sample, not a 300-case primary lane.
The first real case exhausted both 2048- and 4096-token output ceilings with done_reason length; no submission was accepted.
The unchanged four-frame request required 9974 prompt tokens, exceeding 8192; at 16384 it did not complete within the two-minute case ceiling.

decision.next: Use two reviewer-only hosted multimodal model families, with pinned ZDR endpoints and immutable review attestations; keep every reviewer and adjudicator family out of the scored candidate matrix.
